The project uses [oxlint](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter) for linting
and [oxfmt](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter) for formatting (a
Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

tThe project uses [oxlint](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter) for linting
and [oxfmt](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter) for formatting (a
Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

and [oxfmt](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter) for formatting (a
Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

and [oxfmt](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter) for formatting (a
Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

sThe project uses [oxlint](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter) for linting
and [oxfmt](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter) for formatting (a
Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there

  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

aThe project uses [oxlint](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter) for linting
and [oxfmt](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter) for formatting (a
Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

npm run lint
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

and [oxfmt](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter) for formatting (a
Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

sThe project uses [oxlint](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter) for linting
and [oxfmt](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter) for formatting (a
Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there

  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.

  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

tThe project uses [oxlint](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter) for linting
and [oxfmt](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter) for formatting (a
Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

 The project uses [oxlint](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter) for linting
and [oxfmt](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter) for formatting (a
Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

pThe project uses [oxlint](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter) for linting
and [oxfmt](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter) for formatting (a
Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

aThe project uses [oxlint](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter) for linting
and [oxfmt](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter) for formatting (a
Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

tThe project uses [oxlint](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter) for linting
and [oxfmt](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter) for formatting (a
Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):

npm run lint
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

and [oxfmt](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter) for formatting (a
Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

 The project uses [oxlint](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter) for linting
and [oxfmt](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter) for formatting (a
Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

 The project uses [oxlint](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter) for linting
and [oxfmt](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter) for formatting (a
Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

and [oxfmt](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter) for formatting (a
Prettier-compatible formatter). Pull requests will be checked to ensure there
are no lint or formatting issues.

are no lint or formatting issues.

Configuration is shared across `api`, `browse-next`, `types` and `e2e-tests`:

* `.oxlintrc.json` (repo root) holds the common lint rules. Each package has
  its own `.oxlintrc.json` that `extends` it and adds package-specific settings.
* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```

* `.oxfmtrc.json` (repo root) holds the common formatting options (80 column
  width). `api`, `browse-next` and `types` pass it to oxfmt with
  `-c ../.oxfmtrc.json`. `e2e-tests` has its own `.oxfmtrc.json` (100 columns).

To check for lint and formatting issues (run from within a package):
```
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix issues:
```
npm run lint:fix
```
